# The tools of one world

Generated 2026-09-18 from a run of engine/world.py: 40 bands over 14000 years, 38,381 ledger entries, 7,240 distinct things built.

Nobody in this world can read the rules. Bands hold crafts, try combinations of what they already have, and find out about the gates by failing at them. Three gates decide everything: how hot a fire they can raise, how cold they can get, and how finely they can place matter. None of the three is visible to them.

Of the 7,240 things here, 23 have a name in our world and 7,217 do not. The unnamed ones are not errors. They are combinations this world's physics permits that ours never happened to build.

No entry says what a thing is FOR. Purpose was tried and dropped: inferring it from what a band did next is a correlation, not a finding.

## The three gates

```
round     fire   cold   precision   reached
1        1100 K   300 K       1e-01   cordage, edge, heat, lever
2        1100 K   300 K       1e-01   containment, mark, rotation
3        1400 K   300 K       1e-01   breeding, smelting
4        1600 K   300 K       1e-03   gearing
5        1750 K   300 K       1e-03   electricity, optics, pressure, spring
6        1750 K    77 K       1e-06   regulation, steam
7        1750 K    77 K       1e-06   alloy, vacuum
8        1750 K     4 K       1e-06   depiction, semiconductor, superconduction
9        1750 K     4 K       1e-09   switching
10       1750 K     4 K       1e-10   coherence, inference
11       1750 K     4 K       1e-10   placement
```

The precision ladder ends at 5.29e-11 m, the Bohr radius, because matter cannot be placed more finely than an atom is wide. That is a wall and not a rung.

## The crafts

```
edge            a worked face that cuts
                needs nothing  |  tools.stress
cordage         fibre twisted until it holds
                needs nothing  |  tools.breaks
lever           a length trading force for distance
                needs nothing  |  tools.usable
rotation        a bearing and a round thing on it
                needs edge, lever  |  biome.escalation_stops_at
mark            a durable trace standing for a sound
                needs edge  |  literacy.copy_error
breeding        kept records of who bred with whom
                needs mark  |  heredity.copies_per_type
heat            fire held at a temperature
                needs nothing  |  disease.cook_cost_mj
containment     fired clay that holds against a gradient
                needs heat  |  atoms.Pool
smelting        ore reduced past its melting point
                needs heat, containment  |  thermo.effective_temperature
gearing         teeth that carry a ratio
                needs rotation, smelting  |  tools.what_works
optics          glass shaped to bend light
                needs heat, containment  |  senses.diffraction_limit
spring          steel: stored strain released on demand
                needs smelting  |  eos.band
pressure        a vessel that holds against itself
                needs smelting, containment  |  eos.ceiling
steam           heat turned into a stroke
                needs pressure, heat  |  thermo.gamma
regulation      a machine that corrects itself
                needs gearing, spring  |  signal.signal_bits
electricity     charge moved on purpose
                needs smelting, rotation  |  learning.landauer_j
vacuum          a volume with the air taken out
                needs pressure, regulation  |  eos.floor
alloy           composition held to a specification
                needs smelting, regulation  |  atoms.Pool
semiconductor   a crystal pure enough to switch
                needs vacuum, alloy  |  eos.classify
switching       a gate that opens on a signal
                needs semiconductor, electricity  |  learning.landauer_j
inference       statistics run at a scale no head holds
                needs switching, regulation  |  learning.store_bits
depiction       a surface that keeps what light fell on it
                needs optics, alloy  |  senses.diffraction_limit
superconduction resistance gone below a critical temperature
                needs alloy, electricity  |  thermo.cv_molar
coherence       a quantum state held against the noise
                needs superconduction, switching  |  learning.landauer_j
placement       matter set down one atom at a time
                needs coherence, optics  |  eos.classify
```

## Their words for the crafts

A band coins a token when it first makes something. A band that is TAUGHT something learns the word with it, so a craft everybody found separately has a word per band and a craft that spread by teaching has one word that travelled. The oldest words are the least agreed on.

```
craft             words  bands   band 0 calls it
heat                 39     40   kupu
edge                 40     40   susu
cordage              40     40   sutu
lever                39     40   satama
containment           6     40   tuku
mark                  5     40   mumaja
rotation              4     40   kisu
smelting              4     40   sata
breeding              5     40   wutu
gearing               2     40   kulu
pressure              6     40   lawi
electricity           4     40   kakiku
spring                8     40   miji
optics                7     40   jija
steam                 5     40   tisa
regulation           15     40   juwi
alloy                11     40   jiti
vacuum                3     40   liwa
semiconductor        11     40   siwu
superconduction       7     38   tinu
depiction            10     37   puja
switching             7     39   jata
coherence             9     36   suti
inference            11     33   -
placement             4     25   -
```

## The things, in the order they were made

Each entry is headed by what a band that made it calls it, in its own words. The gloss under it is ours, a translation rather than the original. Under that is the drawing: not a picture but a parts table, which is what an engineering drawing's title block and schedule actually carry. Their geometry is ours, so the numbers read straight across.

A part marked *process* reaches its accuracy by the method rather than by measurement -- a lapped lens is true to a quarter wavelength and nobody ever gauged one. A part marked *gauge* has a number somebody must hit, and those are the parts that need a drawing at all.

Below each drawing is the RENDER block: the exact specification that produced the picture of that thing. Solids, radii, heights, stacking order, camera, sun angle and colour, sky, ground albedo, shadow length and penumbra. Nothing in it is a preference -- the solids are forced by what each part does, the order is forced by gravity, and the light is derived from a 5772 K Sun at one astronomical unit. Hand the block to any renderer and it makes the same object under the same sun.
